title: ICE CREAM CAKE
instructions: --Cream three-quarters cup of butter with two cups of fine granulated sugar. Add one cup of milk with two cups of flour and three-quarters cup of corn starch sifted twice with five level teaspoons of baking powder. Fold in slowly the whites of seven eggs and bake in layers.
